screens.name: 01-counters
screens.note: The counters list: name, running total and the + that increments without leaving the screen. The promise.

screens.name: 02-detail
screens.note: One counter: the number big, + and -, the goal ring, and the last 7 days as bars. Free tier, so 7 rather than 14.

screens.name: 03-history
screens.note: The Pro history: every tap across every counter, newest first, grouped by day, over the week and month totals. Needs -pro because no runner can complete a purchase.

screens.name: 04-settings
screens.note: The kit's settings with the Tallies rows: what is on the device, and the erase-everything control.

screens.name: 05-paywall
screens.note: Needs -fakeProducts: a scheme's StoreKit configuration is never honoured by a simctl launch, so real products are unavailable and the CTA would sit disabled.
